description: Oil and Gas Pipeline Segment Applications is a dataset listed in British Columbia data catalogue (BC Data Catalogue), an open data portal, published or maintained by British Columbia Energy Regulator. Pipeline centre-lines associated with oil and gas pipeline activity and falling within the area representing the pipeline right of way. This dataset contains line features for proposed applications collected through the BC Energy Regulator's Application Management System (AMS). The dataset is updated nightly. Coverage: British Columbia. The portal files it under the publisher British Columbia Energy Regulator. Its tags are Application, BC Energy Regulator, BCER, Centre Line, Energy Regulator. It offers 4 resource(s) in ARCGIS_REST, KML, ORACLE_SDE, WMS. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is BC Energy Regulator Open Data License. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support pipeline routing and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-bc-portal.
